trial_court: Family Court - cum - Additional Chief Judge, City Civil Court at Hyderabad, FCOP No.1559 of 2017
case_name: Smt.Y.Naga Sulochana vs K.Chaya Prathap Reddy
facts_of_case: The respondent/husband sought annulment of his marriage with the appellant/wife performed in 2017 on grounds including false information about her date and time of birth. The trial court passed an order and decree dated 23.12.2021, which the appellant felt aggrieved by.

legal_principles.principle: Misrepresentation of date of birth and earlier marriage is not an act of fraud to seek divorce.
legal_principles.held: He has also made alternative submission that misrepresentation of date of birth and earlier marriage is not act of fraud to seek divorce under Section 12(1) (c) of the Act.
cited_cases: Lohia Properties (P) Ltd., Tinsukia, Dibrugarh, Assam v. Atmaram Kumar, (1993) 4 SCC 6

legal_principles.principle: A reasoned order is not open to challenge.
legal_principles.held: However, Sri O.Manohar Reddy, learned Senior Counsel appearing for respondent/husband would submit that the Family Court on consideration of the entire evidence both oral and documentary allowed the said petition annulling the marriage of the parties. It is a reasoned order. There is no error in it.
use_in: family court cases involving appeals against orders

outcome.final_order: The final court order is not specified in this excerpt.
